description: This source file provides utilities for reproducing, debugging, and minifying issues in Torch's Dynamo and backend compilation workflows, especially after graph capture. It includes functions for generating repro scripts, dumping state, wrapping compiler functions with debugging and minification logic, and handling various failure scenarios for debugging and testing purposes.
